name: IRIS — Market: Input Cost Watch
description: Monthly on the 16th at 14:00 UTC. Re-pulls the 17 tracked BLS PPI series one at a time (4s apart) from the public v1 GET endpoint, keeps current + prior year monthly observations, and writes them via iris_inv_series p_kind=ppi. Tolerates BLS quota refusal

parameters.content:
## BLS PPI, one series at a time
The anonymous BLS quota is small and shared per IP, so the 17 series go through a real loop with a 4 second pause between calls rather than 17 concurrent requests.
PCU ids keep their literal dashes - they are percent-encoded as %2D in the path, never stripped.
BLS answers HTTP 200 even when it refuses: status REQUEST_NOT_PROCESSED. Those are recorded in seriesFailed and skipped, so a throttled month writes a partial set instead of crashing.
Series id comes back from the response itself, so labels cannot be attached to the wrong series. M13 (annual average) rows are dropped; only the current and prior year are kept.
